BEFORE THE PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION
                OF THE STATE OF MISSOURI
In the Matter of Evergy Metro, Inc. d/b/a Evergy   )
Missouri Metro’s Request for Authority to          )    Case No. ER-2026-0143
Implement a General Rate Increase for Electric     )
Service                                            )


              ORDER ADMITTING ADDITIONAL HEARING EXHIBITS

Issue Date: November 17, 2026                          Effective Date: November 17, 2026

       On October 27, 2026, The Commission issued Order Directing the Filing of a Joint

Issues Status Pleading and Setting Time for Objections to Commission Exhibits. That Order

stated that the Commission would like to take official notice of the transcript from the

October 13, 2026, on-the-record presentation and would like to take the six filed

nonunanimous stipulations and agreements into evidence as Commission exhibits.

       The Commission allowed until November 6, 2026, for any objections to taking the

transcript and stipulation and agreements into evidence. No objections were received.

       The Commission will admit the transcript and stipulation and agreements onto the

hearing record as set forth in the table below.

 Exhibit          Exhibit
 Number
 550 P/HC         Official Transcript - Volume 12 (On-the-Record Presentation - Jefferson
                  City, MO - October 13, 2026)
 551              Non-Unanimous Stipulation and Agreement Regarding Pensions and
                  Other Post-Employment Benefits (filed October 2, 2026)
 552              Partial Stipulation and Agreement (filed October 2, 2026)
 553              Partial Stipulation and Agreement - Non-C&I Rate Design (filed October
                  2, 2026)
 554              Non-Unanimous Partial Settlement - Rate Design (filed October 5, 2026)
 555 HC           LLPS Partial Stipulation and Agreement (filed October 5, 2026)
  556             Non-Unanimous Programs Stipulation and Agreement (filed October 7,
                 2026)


       THE COMMISSION ORDERS THAT:

       1.    Commission exhibits 550-556 are admitted onto the hearing record.

       2.    This order shall be effective when issued.

                                         BY THE COMMISSION




                                         Nancy Dippell
                                         Secretary


John T. Clark, Senior Regulatory Law Judge,
by delegation of authority pursuant to
Section 386.240, RSMo 2016.

Dated at Jefferson City, Missouri,
on this 17th day of November, 2026.
